CustomField.description: Restricted picklist. Legal values: **Individual**, **Organizational**. Set explicitly on insert; not derived from `DonorId`. Default: `Individual`. Drives the Matching Employer Transactions related list visibility (shown only when `Individual` AND `FQS_Match_Status__c = 'Received'`).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Pick Individual for a personal gift or Organizational for a business or foundation gift. Individual unlocks the Matching Employer Transactions related list.
